title: Runtime and image publication
current: Source defines github.release.create_commit_tag with a serving floor and BASE.YYYYMMDDHHMM from the UTC committer clock. Repeated calls recover an identical annotated tag; minute collisions refuse. The bridge and factories still use launch tags.
